title: Chapter 541
text:
"What did you say? Dragon Emperor? "

Degulish's eyes widened, and his Adam's apple bobbed up and down. His chest felt stuffy, as though he had been shot.

Twenty minutes ago, the hidden team of Blue Star had sent an urgent report. The head of the intelligence department had hurriedly found the current commander of the organization, Deputy Leader Degulish, and reported the situation with a pale face.

Ames had appeared in Blue Star!

The upper echelons of Dark-star were all shocked.

The Dragon Emperor was neutral, but she had suddenly come to the Garton Star System. Could it be that she wanted to interfere with Godora? No, the chances were not high. It was most likely that Black Star had called Ames over. But why did she go to Blue Star?

Degulish was on high alert. No matter how he thought about it, he still could not figure out Ames' intentions.

After analyzing the situation, he felt that there was something strange about this matter. The other party had settled down in Blue Star instead of going to Godora's mother planet to negotiate with the government. It did not seem like she was targeting Dark-star but more like she was here for a vacation.

"Black Star is the leader of Floating Dragon's armed forces, and I heard that he has been expanding his forces recently. Perhaps Ames is here to investigate the development of Floating Dragon," the head of the intelligence department said. "This possibility is the highest."

Degulish nodded slowly and said solemnly, "Don't let your guard down. We still have a grudge with the Dragon Emperor, and she is a variable in our plan. However, as long as we do not provoke her, she will not be able to do anything to us. Even if she is a super expert, she is just an individual. She will not be able to resolve the current situation. "

As he said that, Degulish heaved a sigh of relief. He had been frightened by Ames' name and felt that the situation was very serious. However, after thinking about it, he realized that it was not a big problem.

So what if the Dragon Emperor was very good at fighting? It would be fine as long as she did not appear in front of her. Could it be that she could resolve Godora's problem with her individual strength?

Even a strong person like the Dragon Emperor could not use force to suppress Godora's internal and external problems. She was just one person, and the universe was extremely vast. It was not something that an individual could conquer!

Degulish relaxed, and after thinking for a while, he ordered, "Get the Blue Star's undercover team to pay close attention to Ames's movements. For now, list Blue Star as a restricted area. No one is allowed to get close to Blue Star."

"Uh, I don't think there was any plan to attack Blue Star in the first place." The intelligence officer was helpless. The scene of one of their assault fleets being destroyed by Black Star was still fresh in his mind. Only an idiot would send someone to die.

"By the way, how's the plan to plant a mole in the Black Star Mercenary coming along?"

"I bribed some freelance mercenaries and got them to apply to join the Black Star Mercenary. Black Star does not seem to be recruiting recently, but since they want to expand, the mole I bribed will have a chance to infiltrate sooner or later.

As for bribing the Black Star Mercenaries, I have not taken action yet, and I am not sure of the details of those Black Star Mercenaries. Before I gather enough information and confirm which Black Star Mercenaries can be bribed, I am not prepared to alert them. "

Degulish's eyes flashed, and he sneered. "Very good. This is a plan to kill two birds with one stone. Not only can we infiltrate the Black Star Mercenary, but we can also infiltrate Floating Dragon."

The meeting continued for a while. Regarding the threat of the Dragon Emperor, Degulish only ordered his troops to stay away from Blue Star and did not give any other orders. He felt that this was enough. While Ames was strong, she would not affect the plan that the organization had been preparing for a long time. The most important thing now was to continue with the plan.

What Degulish did not know was that in a place that he could not see, the situation had changed slightly.

He still felt that there was still a lot of time, and the entire Dark-star felt the same way.

They escorted Nagojin's fleet back to Godora's mother planet. This was an extremely large planet that was more than ten times the size of Planet Golden Gate. Dozens of military satellite bases surrounded the mother planet, and the security was extremely tight.

The spaceship landed, and the War Bureau's senior official, who had already received the news, led a group of subordinates to wait at the dock. The moment Nagojin disembarked, this group of people welcomed him.

"How's the item?"

"It's perfectly fine."

"That's great. We don't have time to waste. Let's head to the Research Bureau immediately."

Nagojin headed to the Research Bureau's research base under the escort of a large group of guards. There were even two other Calamity Grade Supers protecting him. The path to the research base was completely sealed off, and even the highest leader of Godora did not receive such treatment.

Nagakin carefully made his way to the research base and handed the Mutation Source over to a group of researchers. They would be researching the Mutation Source in the research lab with the highest security level, and the secrecy level would be the highest. This would prevent any possibility of the secret being leaked.

Nagojin was the key person who had facilitated the transaction with Black Star, and he was allowed to view the results of the research. He waited in the waiting room for half a day, feeling as though he was sitting on pins and needles. Finally, he received the preliminary results of the research on the Mutation Source.

This thing was indeed the main body that had caused the Mutation Disaster!

With the sample that Nagojin had brought back, the research on the antidote would speed up by leaps and bounds!

"That's great!" Nagojin finally relaxed. What he was most worried about was that the sample that Han Xiao had given him was useless.

"Well done."

The War Bureau's senior official heavily patted Nagojin's arm.

"I did not do anything. It's all Black Star's credit."

Nagojin bitterly smiled. Never in his wildest dreams would he have expected that the key person to break the stalemate for Godora would be an outsider.

The War Bureau's senior official's usually stern face could not help but reveal a smile like a blooming chrysanthemum. Regardless of shape or color, it was extremely similar.

"Indeed, Black Star has given us a huge surprise. Who would have thought that he would actually be a mercenary? Heh, he has really solved our urgent situation."

After pausing for a moment, the War Bureau's senior official retracted his smile and solemnly said, "This news must be kept a secret, and we must not leak it out. This is to prevent Dark-star from coming up with another scheme. Maintaining the current situation is the best choice."

In order to deal with Dark-star's continuous attacks, the various departments of Godora were so busy that they did not even have time to sleep. Han Xiao's sudden help had given the upper echelons of Godora a huge surprise. Even the highest leader had paid attention to this mercenary named Black Star and wanted to personally give him a thumbs up.

The War Bureau had simulated the situation, and the result made many of the upper echelons break out in cold sweat.

If Dark-star was allowed to continue unbridled, the situation would only get worse and worse. If this continued for one or two years, Godora's development would be greatly hindered, causing Godora's civilization to regress. Half of their achievements in the Garton Star System would be lost, and the worst-case scenario would even result in internal strife.

Because they knew the consequences, Godora's upper echelons were so excited. The sample provided by Black Star could allow them to avoid huge losses, save countless citizens, and turn the entire situation around!

Han Xiao had become the savior in the eyes of Godora's upper echelons.

"Black Star is an important figure in Floating Dragon. His help can also be seen as Floating Dragon's help. Ames seems to think very highly of him. Perhaps we will be able to benefit from this disaster, and Godora will be able to form a relationship with a transcendental organization like Floating Dragon."

The War Bureau's upper echelon was excited. He pressed on Nagojin's shoulder, and his eyes sparkled. "Black Star's ability is beyond our imagination. You have to maintain a relationship with him. If possible, it's best to take it one step further."

Nagojin's mouth twitched, and he probed, "What do you mean by 'take it one step further'?"

"Make use of the advantage of us Godora and become his close friend!"

The War Bureau's upper echelon said with a serious expression.

Nagojin silently raised his sandbag-sized fist, and golden flames shot out from his body. He looked like a certain race member who had transformed.

"Don't think that I won't dare to beat you up just because you're my superior."

Ever since Ames had arrived, the atmosphere in the Sanctuary had become very strange.

Be it the players, the people in the Sanctuary, the Black Star Mercenaries, or the people of Godora, they were all extremely curious about Ames. Ames did not avoid others either. Her daily life was to look around, and Han Xiao was always by her side.

Han Xiao naturally did not mind being Ames' tour guide. After all, he was very free, and it was rare for the Dragon Emperor to come, so he naturally had to entertain her.

Ames was mainly interested in the players, but considering that this planet was Han Xiao's hometown, she was more low-key and did not do whatever she wanted, such as dissecting the players.

The people in the Sanctuary could often see the two of them walking together on the streets. Thinking about the recent rumors, they could not help but look at Han Xiao and Ames strangely.

Han Xiao noticed the gazes of the passersby. Although he did not show it on his face, he was extremely speechless in his heart.

He felt that the group of officers had lost their minds to spread rumors about him and Ames having a special relationship. He did not care about such rumors, but Ames might not. If she was unhappy, she could casually beat up the mercenaries who spread the rumors.

At that time, should he help her beat them up, or should he help her beat them up?

However, over the past few days, Han Xiao's worries did not come true. Ames did not show any abnormalities. Her expression was normal, and she talked and laughed as usual. Han Xiao would not believe that she did not notice the strange gazes of the passersby.

Thinking about it carefully, how could an expert of this level be affected by such simple rumors?

Han Xiao felt that he was overthinking it. At the same time, he was secretly glad that Ames could not see the player forums.

'Strange gazes of the passersby' was nothing. The players had already made up hundreds of love and hate stories about him and Ames on the forums. The twists and turns of the plots and the perverted characters made his scalp tingle, his lower body tighten, and his heart ache.

The source of all this was Pork Bun's new video. He seriously and meticulously analyzed the relationship between Black Star and the Dragon Emperor. Not only did he have pictures, but he also really said a few things.

Pork Bun said it so seriously that even Han Xiao almost believed it himself. The players were in an uproar, and the bootlickers were on the verge of exploding. The Captain Love Me Again fan club announced that this was a great victory. Both sides started to argue, and the flames of war spread from the Blue Star board to the other novice planets. The foreigners only wanted to ask them to let them live and let them continue to talk about the game!

Pork Bun had always been a very useful publicity ambassador. This was the first time that Han Xiao wanted to strangle him to death. This kind of reporter only wanted to create big news all day, fabricating things out of thin air, making subjective assumptions, ignoring facts, and wanting to see the world in chaos. If a player spread this out and Ames saw it, would he not be afraid of taking responsibility?

However, putting aside all those messy guesses, Pork Bun's bootlicker was on point. Han Xiao had nowhere to vent his anger, and he actually felt a little comfortable being bootlicker.

"I really have to give it to you." Han Xiao facepalmed. He did not plan to open the player forums for the next few days, afraid that his blood pressure would explode.

Ames floated beside him, looking left and right. They were shopping as usual today. Han Xiao composed himself and looked at the walls of the sanctuary in the distance. The players were climbing up and down like ants, modifying the walls.

A few days ago, he had instructed Herlous and Bennett to issue a mission to modify the sanctuary to the players. The modification project officially started, and the players had a new job. They had to show the good tradition of hardworking men who would never complain about being tired. They would transform into building bricks and move them wherever they were needed.

Now that the players had a certain level of strength, their efficiency was much higher than when they were building the sanctuary. Han Xiao estimated that they would definitely be able to complete the modification of the sanctuary within a month.

"No wonder you want to recruit the Inhumans. You seem to have a very high position in their hearts. You must value them a lot," Ames said with a smile.

"There aren't many people in this world that I value. There are only a few billion of them." Han Xiao shrugged.

Ames's eyes curved, and her lips curled into a beautiful arc. She just laughed twice before suddenly stopping and looking ahead. Han Xiao followed her gaze and looked over as well.

Hella and Aurora happened to walk past them. They turned around and saw the two of them. They stopped in their tracks and stopped in front of them.

In the past few days, Hella and Aurora had been busy testing the infected. They had only heard that Han Xiao had brought back a big shot from the universe, but they had not officially met her yet.

This time, it was a chance encounter.

"They are the two sisters you mentioned?" Ames stared at the two of them calmly.

"Yeah." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows slightly.
